g.text: High-concurrency AI routing proxy built on dynamic request
hedging, upstream failover, and low-latency SOCKS5 transport.
Cloud media platform with custom HLS transmuxing, sub-second
audio sync, and automated TMDB metadata curation pipeline.
Minimalist personal finance suite running high-performance SQLite
storage, transient 5-minute OTP verification, and zero telemetry.
QRIS payment verification, Discord gateways, and health polling.
